related_questions.question: Can I get STD testing while on my period?
related_questions.snippet: It's totally okay and normal to get tested for STDs at any point during your menstrual cycle, even on your heaviest days. Your period won't affect the results. STD testing can be quick, easy, and painless. Your nurse or doctor may ask you to take a urine test, cheek swab, blood test, or a physical exam.
related_questions.title: Can you be on your period during STD testing?

text_blocks.snippet: Yes, STD testing can be done while on your period. Most STD tests, like those involving blood or urine samples, are not affected by menstruation. While some swab tests might be slightly less accurate during menstruation, it's generally safe and recommended to get tested even if you're on your period, especially if you have concerns about STDs.
snippet_highlighted_words: Yes, STD testing can be done while on your period

list.title: Blood and urine tests:
list.snippet: These are not affected by menstruation and can be performed at any time during your cycle, including during your period.

list.title: Swab tests:
list.snippet: While some swab tests, particularly those involving the cervix, might be slightly less accurate during your period, it's still generally safe to get them done. If you're concerned about the accuracy of a swab test, you can discuss with your healthcare provider about waiting until after your period or consider a different testing method.

list.title: Importance of testing:
list.snippet: If you have any concerns about STDs, it's important to get tested as soon as possible, even if you're on your period, as early diagnosis and treatment are crucial.
